svg.text: b04 spatial logic + b06 controls + D-048 coordination
P2 PLAN · 18.00 x 15.00 m · +3.80 m STUDY LEVEL

text.tspan: Carry forward the spatial centre of b04/R03.
Retain the verified dimensional corrections of b06/R05.
The previous R05 remains superseded, not erased.

svg.text: 23 doors/openings are checked against shared walls.
Mini deck -> family lounge -> gallery -> protected arrival.
One 1.25 m clear isolatable Phase 2 lobby.
Four D-048 column reservations retained at stair corners.
Primary bathroom 9.8 m2 and dressing room 9.6 m2 remain below the original 17-18 and 15-16 m2 targets
Second independent P2 exit awaits D-021 occupancy and fire review
The X=21 edge truss must preserve the mini-deck view, doors, ceiling and services
Solar control, privacy and final glazing await the selected site and orientation
All dimensions are schematic coordination values.
Wall build-ups and structure remain subject to design.
b04 SPATIAL LOGIC · b06 VERIFIED CORRECTIONS · EXPLICIT ACCESS
Current architectural coordination hypothesis. It does not authorize procurement, fabrication or construction.
